description: This file defines an interface for customer repository operations, including methods for CRUD operations and querying customers with paging.

classes.name: ICustomerRepository
classes.description: An interface providing methods for customer data persistence and retrieval.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by their unique identifier asynchronously.

methods.name: GetPagedAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of customers based on page parameters and optional search term.

methods.name: AddAsync
methods.description: Adds a new customer record asynchronously.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing customer record asynchronously.
